item.title: IEA to release record amount of emergency oil reserves as Middle East war rattles markets
item.summary: The International Energy Agency (IEA) said its 32 members would release a record 400 million barrels from strategic reserves to steady markets as the Middle East war continue to push oil prices higher and threaten global supply.
